intent: Make whole-organism orientation fail closed on stale liveness receipts while projecting fresh PID and port evidence as an explicit tri-state observation, and move the Codex Composer semantic responder's live receipt defaults from the source checkout into its canonical ~/.dharma runtime-state slice. Preserve explicit CLI and state-root overrides, keep repository fixture paths opt-in, and prove default execution cannot churn a checkout.

gates.name: runtime-truth-receipt-custody-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check scripts/governance/orientation_graph.py scripts/runtime/live_ops_census.py scripts/runtime/model_critic_runner.py scripts/runtime/codex_composer_semantic_inbox_drain.py scripts/runtime/codex_composer_semantic_responder.py api/routers/control_surface.py tests/test_orientation_graph.py tests/test_live_ops_census.py tests/test_model_critic_runner.py tests/test_codex_composer_semantic_responder_dlq.py tests/test_control_surface_semantic_receipt_cards.py

commit.message: fix(runtime): make liveness and receipt custody truthful

interface_mismatches: orientation_graph copied status=live from a persisted census without checking generated_at or reconciling it against a current PID/port probe

the semantic responder inherited model, artifact-author, drain, and domain-reply receipt defaults rooted under repository reports even though its durable responder state already lives under ~/.dharma/external_agents/codex_composer/nest/semantic_responder
honest_blockers: Repository tests prove classification and path custody, not current production daemon liveness.
The installed responder must be restarted or otherwise reloaded by the operator after merge before the running process adopts the new defaults; this packet does not restart any service.
Historical checkout-local runtime receipts remain immutable on disk and are not deleted or rewritten by this change.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this pull request as one unit. Do not delete historical runtime receipts and do not restart or stop the installed semantic responder as part of repository rollback.
